TL1-RSRP_Measurement_Period_SSB_Inter: Max(Treport, Ceil(Kgap  (M*N+Lcancel))  Max(MGRP, SSB period)  CSSFinter)
Max(Treport, Ceil(1.5 * Kgap  (M*N+Lcancel))  Max(MGRP, SSB period, DRX cycle)  CSSFinter)

Condition: NOTE 1:The definition of Kgap is the same as L3 measurement which is a scaling factor for a SSB frequency layer to be measured within an associated measurement gap pattern.NOTE 2: If the UE is incapable of multiCellL1-measRTD-greaterThan-CP-r18, the requirements apply for the cells configured by LTM-CSI-ResourceConfig-r18 on which UE is required to perform L1 measurements, when the max RTD among the cells on the same inter-frequency layer is not larger than CP length.NOTE 3:Lcancel is the number of gap occasions cancelled during measurement period TL1- RSRP_Measurement_Period_SSB_Inter. SSB period is the periodicity of the neighbor cell SSB-Index configured for inter-frequency L1-RSRP measurement. TReport is the configured periodicity for reporting.
